prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize performance and recovery for morning strength training session and evening basketball game

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with appropriate timing around morning training and evening game
Includes adequate carbohydrates and protein strategically positioned before and after workouts
Compact format suitable for a single athlete (no excessive detail or redundancy)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a collegiate basketball player who has a morning strength training session and evening game, requiring specific timing of carbohydrate and protein intake around performance windows
